title.zh: 获取直播录制文件列表
title.en: Query live stream recording file list

descriptions.zh: 该接口适用于2022年2月18号之后开通低代码音视频工厂的客户，且适用于开启了直播录制功能，有录制文件生成的场景。
descriptions.en: This operation is applicable to customers who activated the China Short Video China Short Video SDK (China Short Video China Short Video SDK) after February 18, 2022, and is applicable to scenarios in which the live stream recording feature is enabled and recording files are generated.
